title: Meteor Camera Burst by Shower Night
dataSources: Observing sessions (`astronomy:session`), sky quality (`skyquality:reading`), mount telemetry (`mount:session`), focus metrics (`focus:metric`), observatory roof state (`observatory:roof`), sub-frame results (`astroimage:sub`), and all-sky detections (`allsky:event`).
app: Astronomy telemetry from N.I.N.A., KStars/Ekos, Sky Quality Meters, all-sky cameras, focus routines, roof controllers, and image-rejection logs streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=allsky:event event_type="meteor"
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as meteors by _time shower_name
| sort - meteors
description: Ranks nights by meteor count and associates each burst with a named shower when available.
value: A nightly burst view makes an all-sky camera more rewarding by spotlighting the moments when a shower truly peaked for your site.
implementation: Send meteor detections from your all-sky stack with optional shower-name enrichment from the observing calendar.
visualization: Bar chart of nightly meteor counts by shower name.
grandmaExplanation: It records which nights your sky camera saw the most meteors and whether they matched a known shower.
